description: Linéaire des digues gérées par Rennes Métropole pour l'instruction des DT-DICT is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole en accès libre. This layer of lines was created by selecting linear objects from Rennes Métropole's Topographical Large Scale Reference (RTGE) representing the dikes managed by the Direction de la Route Management Traffic Security (DV GTS) department. Be careful, this layer is not intended to represent the dikes precisely from a geographical point of view. Coverage: Rennes Métropole en accès libre. The portal shows the English title as "Linear dykes managed by Rennes Métropole for the instruction of DT-DICT" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Its keywords include inondation, lutte-contre-les-inondations, sante-securite. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
